note: Single machine-readable source of truth for vendored dependency versions. Each entry is verified against the vendored source by tools/check/check_third_party_versions.py; upstream metadata feeds the weekly version-lag report in .github/workflows/sca.yml. Keep this file ASCII-only.

dependencies.name: mbedtls
dependencies.note: 3.6 LTS line. The GitHub archive does not include the framework/ submodule.

dependencies.name: sqlite
dependencies.note: Single-file amalgamation; sqlite3.c carries the same version string.

dependencies.name: freetype
dependencies.note: Version is composed from three macros; no single string macro exists.

dependencies.name: harfbuzz
dependencies.note: hb-version.h.in uses an @HB_VERSION@ placeholder and is not parseable before configure.

dependencies.name: libjpeg-turbo
dependencies.note: cmake/AuroraImageCodecs.cmake mirrors VERSION and LIBJPEG_TURBO_VERSION_NUMBER; the gate also cross-checks that mirror.

dependencies.name: libwebp
dependencies.note: CMakeLists.txt reverse-parses this same AC_INIT line.

dependencies.name: glfw
dependencies.note: docs/html/* are generated copies; the public header is authoritative.

dependencies.name: wgpu-native
dependencies.note: wgpu-native itself ships only 0.0.0 placeholders (Cargo.toml, meson.build) and an Unreleased changelog. The wgpu-core version from Cargo.lock is the only stable proxy; Cargo.toml declares 29.0.1, so the lock file wins.

dependencies.name: wuffs
dependencies.note: Full string carries build metadata (0.3.5+3404.20260711); the numeric release prefix is the comparable version. cmake/AuroraCompression.cmake compiles this exact file.

dependencies.name: stb_image
dependencies.note: STBI_VERSION is a constant API level (1), not the release version; the file-header banner is authoritative.

dependencies.name: webview2
dependencies.note: The vendored tree holds only headers, with no NuGet package manifest. This macro is the SDK-embedded target browser version, the only stable numeric identifier; it is NOT the SDK package version and must not be compared against SDK releases.
